pages.text:
Dearest Ro,

Arthur is safe at school, thank God, and I have told him nothing.

Edmund has written to the Orrin girl. He thinks if she stands where her family should have stood, the house will stop — I can't think of another word — counting. He thinks it has been counting us. He showed me the floor in the photograph: eight pins, seven chairs. The Judge had the picture cut afterwards, because Julian would not be in it. Julian says he will come down but he won't say the words.

I am frightened in a way I can't explain to anyone who hasn't lived in this house.

L.
